Revision: workbook pp. 3–17, PPT lessons 0/1/2a/2b/3; geography question levels, map skills (grid refs, compass), key terms (plate, lithosphere, convection currents, subduction), plate locations, continental drift, 3 plate movements, fold mountains, volcanoes.
